name: Barbados
prevalence_note: Central Bank of Barbados (BiMPay 2026), FSC Barbados & Barbados Revenue Authority (BRA): bank/BiMPay OTP impersonation, investment 'release fee / tax' & upfront-fee job scams, BRA traffic/tax smishing alerts, and Marketplace vehicle deposit scams dominate.
cross_border_note: Uses +1-246 within NANP; fraudsters spoof local bank and government agency messages from foreign +1 and VoIP numbers.

scams.name: Bank / BiMPay Instant-Payment Impersonation & One-Time Code Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Barbadian bank or BiMPay support asking for one-time codes or login details
scams.signals_en: Caller claims to represent a Barbadian bank or credit union investigating a suspicious BiMPay or card transfer and asks for one-time codes, passwords, or clicking an SMS link.
scams.legit_en: Central Bank of Barbados states financial institutions never ask for passwords, one-time codes, or sensitive banking details via unsolicited messages or calls.
bait_tactics: Say you will pause a moment and double-check via the Bridgetown bank switchboard printed on your debit card.
Pretend your mobile screen is frozen and ask them to wait while you restart your old tablet.
Ask them which parish branch holds your account without giving them your name first.

scams.name: Illegal Investment 'Release Fee' & Upfront Employment Fee Scam
scams.name_en: CBB & FSC-warned high-return trading platform demanding withdrawal release fees or crypto/gift cards
scams.signals_en: Promoter shows fake profits claimed by other Barbadians, then demands a 'release fee' or 'tax' via wire, crypto, or gift cards to withdraw funds—or charges an upfront processing fee for an easy job.
scams.legit_en: FSC Barbados and Central Bank of Barbados confirm licensed investment firms never demand upfront withdrawal taxes, gift cards, or pressure wires to foreign accounts.
bait_tactics: Ask for their Financial Services Commission registration details so you can check the FSC Entities Search first.
Insist they deduct the supposed release tax directly from the profit balance shown on the screen.
Say you need to discuss any foreign wire transfer with your credit union manager next week.

scams.name: BRA Traffic / Tax Smishing & Repossessed-Car Deposit Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Barbados Revenue Authority traffic/tax notice or Marketplace vehicle deposit demand
scams.signals_en: Text or follow-up call claiming an unpaid traffic violation or tax refund from BRA with a payment link, or a social-media seller rushing a deposit on a cheap 'repossessed' car.
scams.legit_en: Barbados Revenue Authority confirms it never asks for sensitive personal or payment data via text messages, links, or unsolicited voice calls.
bait_tactics: For a traffic fine claim, say you don't even own a car and ask what vehicle make is on the ticket.
For a Marketplace car, insist on viewing the vehicle and registration papers in person before paying a cent.
Tell them you will check your official TAMIS portal directly rather than opening any text link.
